mapper.insert: insert into oa_feedback ( ticket_no, type, title, module_id, module_name, page_id, page_name, content, steps, expect_result, is_anonymous, status, submitter_id, submitter_name, submit_time, del_flag, create_time, update_time ) values ( #{ticketNo}, #{type}, #{title}, #{moduleId}, #{moduleName}, #{pageId}, #{pageName}, #{content}, #{steps}, #{expectResult}, #{isAnonymous}, #{status}, #{submitterId}, #{submitterName}, #{submitTime}, '0', sysdate(), sysdate() )
mapper.update: update oa_feedback set status = '1', reply_content = #{replyContent}, reply_by = #{replyBy}, reply_by_name = #{replyByName}, reply_time = sysdate(), update_time = sysdate() where feedback_id = #{feedbackId} and del_flag = '0'
update oa_feedback set status = '0', reply_content = null, reply_by = null, reply_by_name = null, reply_time = null, update_time = sysdate() where feedback_id = #{feedbackId} and del_flag = '0'

update oa_feedback set status = '1', reply_content = #{replyContent}, reply_by = #{replyBy}, reply_by_name = #{replyByName}, reply_time = sysdate(), update_time = sysdate() where del_flag = '0' and status = '0' and feedback_id in
#{item}

update oa_feedback set del_flag = '1', update_time = sysdate() where del_flag = '0' and feedback_id in
#{item}
mapper.select: select count(case when status = '0' then 1 end) as pendingCount, count(case when status = '1' then 1 end) as repliedCount, count(case when submit_time >= curdate() then 1 end) as todayCount, count(case when submit_time >= date_sub(curdate(), interval weekday(curdate()) day) then 1 end) as weekCount from oa_feedback where del_flag = '0'
select max(cast(substring(ticket_no, 11) as unsigned)) from oa_feedback where ticket_no like concat('FB', #{datePart}, '%')

select menu_id as id, menu_name as name, parent_id as parentId, menu_type as menuType from sys_menu where status = '0' and visible = '0' and menu_type in ('M', 'C') order by menu_type desc, parent_id asc, order_num asc
